identity: A step-by-step form shows one group of fields at a time, a step indicator, controls to move between steps, a review page, and a confirmation screen.

scenarios.name: checkout
scenarios.screen: The account step shows empty email, full name, and phone fields, with a step indicator and a Next button. Later steps and the review are hidden, and no dropdown or error message is open.
never: A payment form alongside the account fields

arrangements.text: The step indicator sits above a vertical stack of account fields, with Next below the fields.
The step indicator sits to the left of the account fields, with labels beside the inputs and Next beneath them.

scenarios.name: application
scenarios.screen: The personal details step shows empty first name, last name, email, and phone fields, with a step indicator and a Next button. The experience, availability, consent, and review steps are hidden; no error message is shown.
never: An employer field beside the personal details

arrangements.text: The step indicator sits above a vertical stack of personal details fields, with Next below the fields.
The step indicator sits to the left of the form, with the name fields side by side above email and phone and Next below.

scenarios.name: booking
scenarios.screen: The stay step shows empty destination, check-in date, nights, and guests fields, with a step indicator and a Next button. The guest, room, and review steps are hidden; no picker or error message is open.
never: Room choices beside the stay fields

arrangements.text: The step indicator sits above a vertical stack of stay fields, with Next below the fields.
The step indicator sits to the left of the form, with destination and check-in above side-by-side nights and guests fields and Next below.

scenarios.name: signup
scenarios.screen: The account step shows empty username, email, password, and confirm password fields, with a step indicator and a Next button. The profile, preferences, and review steps are hidden; no dropdown or error message is open.
never: Theme choices beside the account fields

arrangements.text: The step indicator sits above a vertical stack of account fields, with Next below the fields.
The step indicator sits to the left of the account fields, with labels beside the inputs and Next beneath them.
